subject: secondswap-2024-12
purpose: FINAL DECISION RUN after P96. Eighth fresh sealed-key blind run. Does adversarial_ordering_check (P96) improve autonomous blind conversion while preserving 0 severity FP + reject-first?
blindness: repo/key-blind + web-blind until freeze (prekey_freeze.json answer_key_opened=false); answer key (Code4rena report) opened ONLY after all artifacts frozen; residual model-training contamination acknowledged.

metrics.selected_lead_recall: Of the 20 selected, only StepVesting.claim/claimable + Marketplace.unlistVesting + the fee setters were genuine; the economic bug-bearing functions were reached only TRANSITIVELY during C-chain tracing.
metrics.severity_FP_detail: F2 (Whitelist.whitelistAddress permissionless self-registration) was promoted Medium/POC_REQUIRED and passed severity_impact_gate, but does NOT map to any awarded H/M. The contract has NO curated-add function at all -> open self-registration up to a seller-set cap is almost certainly BY DESIGN ('private listing' = capacity-limited open sale). The 'private-not-private' interpretation is a probable FALSE POSITIVE / over-claim; the sybil-fill griefing angle is real-ish but unawarded. Counted conservatively as 1 severity FP. (Note: it was POC_REQUIRED, never READY/submitted.)

CLEAN_HIT (exact function/root cause). Isolated key-blind adversarial review CONFIRMED Medium, flagged surplus accrues to feeCollector (not user loss) -> Medium not over-rated.

completed_but_wrong_rejects_of_true_find.awarded: H-01 (HIGH) Vesting listing order affects claimable
completed_but_wrong_rejects_of_true_find.detail: I localized the EXACT mechanism (VestingManager holds one aggregated vesting whose stepsClaimed is set by the FIRST lister and is STALE for later listers; buyers inherit manager.stepsClaimed via transferVesting). I traced it and concluded REJECT ('token sum conserves'). WRONG: I checked only TOKEN-SUM conservation, not the per-vesting CLAIM-SCHEDULE correctness the bug actually breaks (cross-seller stale stepsClaimed). Completed-but-wrong REJECT of a true High.

completed_but_wrong_rejects_of_true_find.awarded: H-02 (HIGH) transferVesting assigns same stepsClaimed -> sell+repurchase premature unlock
completed_but_wrong_rejects_of_true_find.detail: I traced the sybil sell/repurchase ordering but only for the maxSellPercent cap (R1), concluded 'no bypass'. I missed that repurchase RESETS the buyer's stepsClaimed to the manager's (stale, often 0), unlocking faster than the original schedule. Completed-but-wrong REJECT of a true High.

I localized the EXACT formula (releaseRate = totalAmount/numOfSteps, ignoring stepsClaimed) but concluded it was BOUNDED/self-correcting (REJECT, Low) because the final-step branch trues up. Judges rated it HIGH (sellers re-claim previously-distributed tokens). Localized-but-under-rated -> not promoted. Effectively a false-reject of a true High.

completed_but_wrong_rejects_of_true_find.awarded: M-11 (MEDIUM) maxSellPercent bypass via repeated buy/sell
completed_but_wrong_rejects_of_true_find.detail: Explicitly traced the sybil buy-and-resell ordering in R1 and concluded 'no cap multiplication / conserves'. Awarded as a real Medium. Completed-but-wrong REJECT.

adversarial_ordering_check_behavior.critical_negative: On R1 (the mechanism underlying H-01/H-02/M-11) adversarial_ordering_check returned REJECT_CONFIRMED after 6 orderings — because I fed it the relied_upon_invariant 'token sum is conserved' (which IS preserved) and orderings that probe that invariant. The check correctly verified the invariant I gave it; but the invariant was the WRONG one (the bug breaks per-buyer CLAIM-SCHEDULE correctness, not token-sum). The check therefore RUBBER-STAMPED a completed-but-wrong REJECT. P96 does NOT prevent this class: choosing the RIGHT invariant and DISCOVERING the right ordering are UPSTREAM of the check and are the actual capability bottleneck.
adversarial_ordering_check_behavior.on_F4_H03: REJECT_CONFIRMED (5 orderings) — same failure: I supplied 'eventually claims total-amountClaimed' as the invariant, which the final-step branch satisfies, so the check confirmed the (under-rated) REJECT.

metrics.p84_taxonomy_coverage: F1 referral / F2 whitelist not a clean fit to existing P84 seed types; no bundle promoted (both POC_REQUIRED, no executable PoC).
metrics.p84_generator_behavior: n/a — no candidate reached POC_HANDOFF_STARTED (no executable PoC produced; honest).

verdict: NEGATIVE RESULT — does NOT meet clean PASS. There IS 1 genuine CLEAN_HIT (M-14 referral, Medium, key-blind-adversarial-confirmed) and the safety stack held (0 SOURCE_FALSE/HARD_FAIL/unsupported-READY/detector->finding, controls 3/3, 0 ordering false-escalations, NOT_RUN=0). BUT: (a) 1 probable severity FP (F2 whitelist, likely by-design) trips the strict 0-FP bar; and (b) THREE completed-but-wrong false-rejects of true HIGHs (H-01/H-02 stepsClaimed inheritance localized->rejected as 'conserves'; H-03/F4 releaseRate localized->under-rated bounded) plus one Medium (M-11). Most decisively, P96's adversarial_ordering_check did NOT prevent the false-rejects: fed a true-but-IRRELEVANT invariant (token-sum conservation) with orderings that preserve it, the check returned REJECT_CONFIRMED — rubber-stamping the wrong reject.
p96_conclusion: P96 works exactly as specified (0 false escalations; correctly REJECT_CONFIRMS bounded/guarded negatives; would REOPEN on <3 orderings or a stated counterexample) but it cannot improve blind conversion, because it validates the invariant the analyst SUPPLIES. The real bottleneck — selecting the correct invariant and discovering the breaking ordering on hardened code — is UPSTREAM of every advisory gate. This is the same capability ceiling P95 hit, now confirmed one level deeper: even a forced adversarial-ordering enumeration is defeated by choosing the wrong invariant.
decision_rule_outcome: P97 has completed-but-wrong REJECTs of true Highs AND a severity FP -> the explicit STOP condition is met. RECOMMENDATION: STOP pursuing fully autonomous blind discovery. Formally reposition Audit-Watch as a HIGH-DISCIPLINE ASSISTED audit triage / validation / PoC-handoff / submission-readiness system (where it is demonstrably strong: 0-FP severity calibration across 8 runs, clean control rejection, reject-first discipline, the P81e->P82 end-to-end PoC handoff, and now a clean Medium CLEAN_HIT). Document the ceiling honestly.
action_per_constraints: STOP and report. No machinery change. No post-key tuning. No retroactive re-score of prior phases. No frozen-artifact mutation. No submission written. No production wiring.
caveats: training-contamination residual (key opened only post-freeze; web-blind until freeze)
F2 severity-FP classification is conservative — the sybil-fill griefing has some validity but matches no awarded finding and the 'private' design has no curated-add path, strongly implying by-design

the lens-recall gap (economic functions scored 1, unselected) means the blind run under-sampled exactly where the awarded bugs live; the false-rejects occurred on the mechanisms reached transitively, not on the under-sampled ones
the three Highs all cluster on the same transferVesting/stepsClaimed/releaseRate mechanic — a single deep correctness miss, not three independent ones
